title: Cloud City: Operations & Process Improvement: Platform Engineering & Reviews
city_concept: City Public Works Department & Civic Operations

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Every shop owner had to dig their own sewer ditch and pave their own sidewalk, creating a patchwork of broken gravel and overflowing gutters.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Mayor Meridian established the Public Works Department (Platform Engineering): providing standardized paved roads, clean water mains, and street sweepers.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: Public Works conducted quarterly city audits, repairing cobblestones before wagons broke their axles.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Physical city infrastructure maintenance requires heavy earthmovers; cloud platform automation updates thousands of resources via declarative APIs.
